pokedexEntries.bk: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.

pokedexEntries.wh: It administers sharp, powerful pecks with its bill. It whips its long neck to deliver forceful repeated strikes.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: Despite their elegant appearance, they can flap their wings strongly and fly for thousands of miles.
